rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow APA finality decision holding the Air Force’s permit-renewal application is not “final agency action” because any legal consequences depend on Guam EPA’s independent permitting decision, so NEPA/RCRA merits are not reached. A Sotomayor dissent (possibly with Jackson writing or joining separately) is the most probable separate writing, emphasizing pragmatic finality and NEPA’s timing concerns.
